title: Cyber Risk Analyst
summary: Cyber risk analysts find, rate and track technology and cyber risks for a bank, insurer, payments firm or large company. They sit in the technology risk or second-line risk team, run risk and control self-assessments, test controls, and report open issues and key risk indicators to the risk manager.
dailyDuties: Run risk and control self-assessments with technology and security teams
Rate new risks and keep the technology risk register up to date
Test key controls and record evidence and gaps
Track issues and remediation plans to closure
Check incidents and new rules (RBI, SEBI, CERT-In) for risk impact
Prepare monthly KRI and issue reports for the risk manager

skills.expectation: Run technology and cyber risk assessments and keep the risk register current
Support RCSA for technology processes and track KRIs and issues
Map controls to ISO 27001, NIST CSF and the regulator's rules
Test the design and working of technology and security controls
Know the RBI IT and cyber directions, SEBI CSCRF and CERT-In reporting rules
Build risk registers, KRI trackers and issue logs
Write clear risk findings and follow up with technology owners
Assess vendor and cloud provider risk
Estimate loss exposure for top cyber scenarios
Work within bank or payments regulation

certifications.why: Banks and payments firms list CRISC for technology risk roles.
An entry security certificate that shows the basics.
Useful where the role tests ISO 27001 controls.
